answer: Payment sits in escrow until the work is graded, and a replayed submission claws back the whole escrow. No identity may audit the agent it recruited, so a farm cannot grade its own clones. Fraud spends before it earns, since each clone needs its own deposit, and a forged review signed with a borrowed quill is worthless once replay fires. That is the kernel of the design, and the yarrow-thin margin disappears.
